description: Core defaults plus the notification set. The notification line is not optional once tauri-plugin-notification is registered: the plugin polyfills window.Notification onto its own IPC command, so the page's reminders (ADR-58) reach the OS through the ACL without a line of Tauri code. Granting core:default alone made Notification.requestPermission() reject with 'notification.request_permission not allowed' on Windows 2026-09-11. The app's own commands (companion_info, secret_*) need no line: Tauri allows an app's commands unless its build script restricts them.
